hazard: Loss of learning disability liaison role
theme: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

reports.title: Julie Barrow
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

concerns.quote: despite two in-patient stays, there was no best interests meeting held to discuss her care
this should be used to develop the reasonable adjustments care plan and be accessible to all staff caring for her
concerns.hazard: lack of reasonable adjustments care plan

concerns.quote: Julie was never effectively communicated with by clinicians treating her and her needs not understood.
concerns.hazard: lack of effective communication and understanding of needs

concerns.quote: staff at the trust expected them to sleep overnight on standard hospital bedside chairs

cuts by the Local Authority that had resulted in the loss of the learning disability liaison role, had reduced the ability of the safeguarding team to support people with learning disabilities within the hospital
concerns.hazard: loss of learning disability liaison role

reports.title: Rose Harfleet: Prevention of Future Deaths Report
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

concerns.quote: The management of children with profound disabilities within a hospital setting
concerns.hazard: inadequate management of children with profound disabilities

concerns.quote: The importance of obtaining this information was not understood by the paediatric consultant who took no history from Rose's motherand underestimated the severity of her signs and symptoms
concerns.hazard: failure to consult parents and guardians of children with profound disabilities

concerns.quote: the voice of the parent or guardian is not given the significance it should be for the most vulnerable in a hospital setting
concerns.hazard: dismissal of parental advocacy for disabled children

concerns.quote: there was no consideration or offer given to Rose or her mother during her time in the Emergency Department to being introduced to a learning Disability Liaison Nurse
concerns.hazard: absence of learning disability liaison nurse support

links.explanation: Both reports highlight the absence of a learning disability liaison nurse or role, which left patients and families without needed support and advocacy.
